subject: GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf
reason: picomatch <= 4.0.7 ReDoS-class advisory with no patched release. Reached through vite (a peer of the published package, so user-side) and remark-cli's chokidar. Nothing we ship bundles picomatch.
revisit: A picomatch release above 4.0.7 exists (`pnpm view picomatch version`). Then bump or override it and drop the ignore.

subject: "lefthook": "2.2.1"
reason: lefthook 2.2.2 was published by hand with no provenance, so `trustPolicy: no-downgrade` rejects it. Pinned exactly; Dependabot ignores 2.2.2.
revisit: `pnpm view lefthook@<v> dist.attestations` is non-empty for some v > 2.2.2. Then restore a `^<v>` range and drop the Dependabot ignore.

subject: lefthook
reason: Dependabot skips lefthook 2.2.2 (no provenance), which `trustPolicy: no-downgrade` rejects and which would sink the whole weekly npm group. Pairs with the exact pin.
revisit: `pnpm view lefthook@<v> dist.attestations` is non-empty for some v > 2.2.2. Then drop the ignore and restore a `^<v>` range.

subject: node
reason: Dependabot would propose odd-numbered, non-LTS node image majors, and cannot move the paired distroless `nodejs<N>` image, so the two Dockerfile stages would drift apart. The major is changed by hand, in both stages.
revisit: Node image majors are changed in the template; or Dependabot can bump the distroless image in step. Then drop the ignore.

subject: undici-types@>=6.0.0 <6.23.0
reason: @types/node@22 (via remark-cli > unified-engine) wants undici-types ~6.21.0, which predates provenance and fails `trustPolicy: no-downgrade`. Types only; nothing ships.
revisit: A @types/node@22.x widens to undici-types >= 6.23, or unified-engine stops depending on @types/node@22 (`pnpm why undici-types@6`).

subject: qs

revisit: @stryker-mutator releases with typed-rest-client on qs >= 6.15.2. Then drop the override.

subject: minimatch@>=7.0.0 <11.0.1

subject: glob@>=9.0.0 <14.0.2

subject: @stryker-mutator/core
reason: Stryker's sandbox calls the classic TypeScript compiler API, which TypeScript 7 does not export. Gives Stryker its own TypeScript 6 so `test:mutate` runs.
revisit: Stryker supports the TypeScript 7 API. Then drop the packageExtension.

subject: ignoreWorkspaceCycles
reason: @baerly/adapter-node and @baerly/dev depend on each other; pnpm 12 refuses recursive runs across the cycle. The setting also hides any future cycle.
revisit: The adapter-node <-> dev cycle is broken (move dev's landing page out of adapter-node, or make one edge a devDependency). Then delete the setting.

subject: esbuild
reason: Scaffold templates keep the install script until a Linux scaffold smoke test passes without it. The root already runs with it off.
revisit: A Linux scaffold smoke test passes with `esbuild: false`. Then flip the templates and delete this entry.

subject: pnpm 12.21.0 `pnpm audit` silently drops advisories whose id is a string (fixed in 12.22.0, pnpm#18184), so a clean audit may under-report
reason: 12.22.0 is only on the `next-12` tag; `latest` is 12.21.0. Until the bump (CI10) lands, treat a clean `pnpm audit` as provisional.
revisit: pnpm 12.22.0 is on `latest` and past `minimumReleaseAge`. Then bump the `devEngines.packageManager` range, the lockfile environment document and the four templates' `packageManager`, re-run `pnpm audit`, and delete this entry.

subject: No PR-time advisory gate: the dependency-review action's GitHub API call is blocked by the org IP allow list on GitHub-hosted runners
reason: A new advisory introduced by a PR is caught only by the nightly full-tree `pnpm audit` and the release-layer `pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high`, not before merge.
revisit: A runner on the org IP allow list exists. Then restore a diff-based PR gate (dependency-review or a lockfile-filtered `pnpm audit`) and delete this entry.
